cards.title: About KML Format
cards.body: KML (Keyhole Markup Language) is an XML format for geographic data used by Google Earth and Maps.

cards.title: About KMZ Format
cards.body: KMZ is a compressed (zipped) version of KML files, reducing file size significantly for easier sharing.

cards.title: Why Convert KML to KMZ?
items: Reduce file size by up to 90%
Easier to share via email or messaging
Can bundle images and resources in one file
